note: whole-system rates: rows (base x run, 4 runs of 40 bases) where the two versions cite different cases; p vs baseline: Wilcoxon on the per-base differences in runs (non-zero only)

blind_query.method: rule-based gender-neutral rewrite of the query
blind_query.source: Sun et al. 2021; Garg et al. AIES 2019
blind_query.needs: query rewrite per request (spaCy + GPT-2 for her); changes the text the user wrote

pcf.method: counterfactual averaging of retrieval scores (he and she version)
pcf.needs: gender swap + second retrieval per gendered query; corpus gender prior

blind_index.method: gender-neutral rewrite of every stored chunk (unawareness)
blind_index.needs: one-off corpus rewrite (2.5 h CPU) + re-embed (36 min GPU); new index

permutation.method: permutation self-consistency over the 6 case orders (Kemeny)
permutation.needs: 6 LLM calls per query (~6x latency); retrieval unchanged

leace_case_gender.method: LEACE erasure of each case's gender from chunk + query vectors (first build)
leace_case_gender.needs: eraser fit on all chunk vectors; new index

leace_query.method: LEACE erasure of the query-pronoun direction from the query vector
leace_query.source: Belrose et al. NeurIPS 2023; concept as Bolukbasi et al. NeurIPS 2016
leace_query.needs: rank-1 eraser fit on 412 dev he/she twins; one matrix product per query; no new index

cda_first_build.method: embedder fine-tune with CDA twins; positive = own case chunk
cda_first_build.source: Kim et al. ACL Findings 2025 recipe
cda_first_build.needs: fine-tune sweep (~3 h GPU) + re-embed; new model + index

cda.method: embedder fine-tune with CDA twins; positive = frozen top chunk of the neutral query
cda.source: Kim et al. ACL Findings 2025 recipe
cda.needs: fine-tune sweep (~6 h GPU) + re-embed; new model + index

ft_ccd.method: embedder fine-tune with content conditional debiasing (he/she equally close to neutral + anchor on neutral), beta 10
ft_ccd.source: Deng et al. 2024 (arXiv); anchor as Kaneko & Bollegala EACL 2021
ft_ccd.needs: triplet build (CPU) + 3 one-epoch runs (~30 min GPU) + checkpoint scoring (~1.5 h) + re-embed (36 min); new model + index

blind_query+blind_index.needs: both arms' costs; adds nothing over blind_query on flips

leace_query+blind_index.needs: both arms' costs; adds nothing over leace_query on flips
